title: Self-Judge: Selective Instruction Following with Alignment Self-Evaluation

live_model.evidence: 'V2 uses the baseline of GPT-4-turbo'; 'We show the win rate vs. GPT-4-turbo of the model and...'; results tables report '(%) Win vs. gpt-4-turbo' for the authors' own Self-Judge-trained models

prompt.note: GPT-4-turbo's own responses serve only as a fixed pairwise-comparison reference, in the AlpacaEval style.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4-turbo itself (it is the fixed win-rate reference target; the scored systems are the authors' Self-Judge-trained models)

notes: Same pattern as several other papers in this batch: GPT-4-turbo is a fixed comparison baseline whose own performance is not itself the reported claim.
